name: NSynth Dataset
description: A dataset of 305,979 four-second audio recordings of musical notes, annotated with instrument family, instrument source, pitch, velocity, and other sound attributes, designed for research in machine learning for music.
citation: Engel, J., Hantrakul, L., Gu, C., and Roberts, A. (2019). NSynth: A Dataset for Musical Note Synthesis. https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.01279
